h: Divine Consolation Reveals the Purpose of Exile

p: "Because the Holy One, blessed is He,
and it lists there all the prophets
Here are consolations given to you?
shall we believe the first words
And it lists all of them,
to the Holy One, blessed is He,
and say to Him: Master of the world,
The Holy One, blessed is He, said to them:
I and you will go to her
that Hashem Yisbarach goes with them?
the pesukim of punishment and rebuke
Further it says in the Pesikta
"They said to Him: Master of the world,
מִפְּנֵי מָה לֹא עָשִׂיתָ לִי כְּיוֹסֵף
why have You not done for me as Yosef did?
'Would that You were as a brother to me'
his brothers repaid him with evil, etc.,
and when they came into his hand
he repaid them with good, etc.:
for so it is written here (Yeshayahu 40:2):
And we must understand the connection:
that he would not do them harm,
that he could not harm them,
wished to destroy one star," etc.
when in truth the punishment came,
and already nearly two thousand years
and we have still not been saved?
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
according to what is written in the holy Zohar
that the whole essence of the exiles
that are in the nations of the world;
for in all of them are found
"And You give life to them all";
which is the root of life.
there is wisdom among the nations,
'Among the nations there is no Torah'";
that this is the matter of
what they said, of blessed memory (Pesachim 87b):
"so that converts be added to them."
And then, when they have extracted from them
all the holiness and the life,
And this is why it says,
for the essential purpose of the exiles
"My saying — imrasi — shall distill as the dew"
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג פח, ב)
for they are the words of the living God,
and they come into the heart of the sages
and it seems that they are the ones originating them,
"'The word of Hashem' — this is halachah";
which corresponds to the attribute of Malchus
פֶּה תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה קָרִינַן לָהּ
"the mouth; we call it Torah she'b'al peh"
it says in the holy Zohar
for this reason it is called Yerushalayim,
and regarding the eating of ma'aser sheni
"And you shall eat before Hashem your God," etc.,
to fear Hashem your God," etc.;
for when it was the camp of the Shechinah,
and it brought fear into the heart;
(in the Rema's gloss at the beginning of Orach Chaim):
that the King of the kings of kings,
the Holy One, blessed is He,
immediately fear will come upon him," etc.
And this is the attribute of Malchus,
corresponding to which is the Name Ad-nai,
"For from Tziyon shall go forth Torah,
and the word of Hashem from Yerushalayim";
for the essence of Torah she'b'al peh,
whence instruction goes out to the world;
to the place from which fear goes out to the world."
but has no fear of Heaven.
And this is the meaning of
that the essential purpose of the exiles
is to extract from them the vitality,
which is the aspect of Torah she'b'al peh,
it does not say "and call her"
And this is in the manner of
"'Even though they hire among the nations,
now I will gather them' (Hoshea 8:10), etc.:
"That her term of service is fulfilled"
this is according to what is written
it is in the hand of Hashem Yisbarach
and to say that the time has already come;
for even in the exile of Mitzrayim,
(as is written in Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:8);
and all the more so in this End,
to My limbs I did not reveal it."
these are the first three sefiros,
which are the seven lower sefiros,
depicted in the form of a man
to them "I did not reveal it."
that reaches from end to end,
the End was revealed to him;
and when he sought to reveal it,
that is, that it be also in the revealed,
it was closed off from him
that as long as it is in the hidden things,
which is the aspect of Atika,
even though the End is in time,
that the time and the End have already arrived;
as it says in the Gemara
if you will listen to His voice" (Tehillim 95:7).
And this is "that her term of service is fulfilled."
for so it was in His will
from the six days of Creation
that is, they will be like merits;
that there be light from within darkness
And when it arises in His will, may He be blessed,
to say "that her term of service is fulfilled,"
then He can put into Yisrael
that they all do teshuvah out of love,
by which willful sins become like merits.
he knew then the state of Yisrael,
that they were not worthy of redemption;
if you will listen to His voice";
for it is in Hashem's hand to bring them back in teshuvah,
and they will be included in
"if you will listen to His voice."
"That she has received from the hand of Hashem
of the Holy One, blessed is He,
"that she has received from the hand of Hashem"
from the hand of the Name Havayah,
which is the attribute of mercy,
that it was truly for the good,
so that they merit in exile
that were accepted by the heart of Yisrael,
who felt the consolation in the heart,
that it is from Hashem Yisbarach for the good.
"On the day that Hashem gives you rest," etc.,
that is, since it is written "on the day that He gives rest"
it implies that there is a special day
rest in the heart of Yisrael,
and it is the Shabbos day.
meaning: even though they are still now
Yisrael have rest in the heart,
for he knows that it is from Hashem Yisbarach,
he feels the consolation in the heart.

— “The Gemara asks: What is the meaning of the phrase: “For the day of vengeance is in My heart”? Rabbi Yoḥanan says that it means that God said: I revealed the day of vengeance to My heart, but I did not reveal it to My limbs, as it were, as I never stated it explicitly. Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish says that it means that God said: I revealed this secret to My heart, but I did not reveal it to the ministering angels.”
